items.headline: U.S. Approves $2.1 Billion Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
items.summary: The U.S. State Department has approved a potential $2.1 billion sale of 500 Patriot air defense missiles to Ukraine, with funding provided by European allies and Canada. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy welcomed the decision but warned that deliveries could take years when interceptors are urgently needed to defend against winter attacks.

items.headline: Hackers Steal Record $6.3 Billion from Binance in Massive Cyberattack
items.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance temporarily suspended withdrawals after cybercriminals stole over six billion dollars in digital assets in the largest cyber theft on record. The platform pledged to fully reimburse affected users as cybersecurity experts investigate how attackers breached the exchange's security framework.

items.headline: Milwaukee Brewers Win First World Series Championship in Franchise History
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to secure the first World Series title in their 57-year history. Catcher William Contreras earned Series MVP honors after helping lead the team through a dominant 11-2 postseason run.

items.headline: General Hospital and The Kelly Clarkson Show Win Big at the 53rd Daytime Emmy Awards
items.summary: The 53rd Daytime Emmy Awards took place in Los Angeles, with ABC's long-running soap opera General Hospital taking home Outstanding Daytime Drama Series for the sixth consecutive year. The Kelly Clarkson Show captured Outstanding Daytime Talk Series, alongside key lead acting victories for Tamara Tunie and Scott Clifton.
